scope: Single exposed-data hypothesis; not fresh holdout or paper deployment
formula: current first-five-minute QQQ volume / mean of previous 14 trading sessions same-window volume
formula_interpretation: Use t-i in denominator, documenting the paper t-1 printed-index inconsistency.

source.title: A Profitable Day Trading Strategy For The U.S. Equity Market

transfer_limit: Paper uses stocks-in-play universe, breakout stop entries and top-20 selection; this QQQ timed-entry filter is a project transfer hypothesis, not replication.
input: Previously exposed A/B original sealed SIP/raw 1m CSV with June warmup
held_fixed: original .0035/share .35 minimum commission, full spread 2bps and slippage 1bp per side
capital: Independent 100000 start per stage and per arm; each arm carries its own full daily capital
baseline_gate: Original R1 complete fills and daily results must match exactly before interpreting variant
result_policy: No winner or automatic Paper promotion from exposed A/B; publish both stages and all attempts. Do not rescue a failure with more thresholds in this experiment.
